title: result.json delivery contract (reading)
description: One result.json per case. Contract fields come from case.json → output_contract and are copied by name; the skill never renames them.

output_contract.description: One key per contract field, with the delivered value.

status.description: success only when every candidate was annotated, every quote verified, and no source field is missing.

uncertainty.description: A claim that produced no record belongs here, not nowhere.

consistency_rules: records dropped because no candidate could be annotated must appear as unannotated_claim
a quote that failed verbatim binding must appear as bind_failure, not be silently replaced
source metadata that the paper does not carry stays `not_reported` and is listed in source_metadata_missing
any status other than success carries status_reasons
